msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Since you’ve completed the referral and e-learning, the *Open Water Referral Course* sounds like the right option. One important note: a refresher is for already-certified divers, while the referral course is for completing your first certification. If neither of you is certified yet, the mini-course is a try-dive and does *not* count toward the PADI course.

To complete an Open Water course started at another PADI center, you need a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; this is the Open Water Referral Course, not a regular dive trip.

The two-day referral course requires an overnight stay on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. The mini-course is a separate activity, so please check that its timing works with your referral course dates.

*Open Water referral course*, depending on where you start from (online price per person):
• *From Cartagena*: 474 USD, round-trip boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita; lunch included.
• *Already on the islands*: 432 USD, pickup at your hotel if it has sea access; no lunch.

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊

msg: Anything needs to be completed beforehand? I’m gonna need a little refresher.
reply:
If it’s been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. It’s a great way to get comfortable again: it includes a pool review and one ocean dive with an instructor.

Beforehand, you’ll need to complete the medical form: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. After booking, you’ll receive the theory by email and must complete it before the practical session. You’ll also receive the insurance form and liability waiver, and you’ll need to show your certification card—either a photo beforehand or the card on the day.

After more than 2 years without diving, a refresher is normally needed before the trip; a refresher or PADI ReActivate completed at another center counts as your refresher.

Are you departing from Cartagena or already staying on the Rosario Islands?
